name: 92028 · Fallbrook, CA
findings: ZIP 92028 (Fallbrook) has 147 nonprofit organizations. 80 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92028 (Fallbrook) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92028 (Fallbrook) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
